# PIN MAP — every cavity, box side and leg side

*Rev 2026-08-30 · owns: cavity assignments. GENERATED — see the note below.*

*Generated by `05-PROCESS/tools/gen.py` from `02-HARNESS/data/*.csv` — edit the CSV, not this table.*

**This file is the authoritative cavity map** (README conventions). It is generated, so it cannot drift from `SPEC.md`, `CHANNEL-SCHEDULE.md`, `CUT-LIST.md` or `channels.h` — they all come from the same CSV. To change a cavity, edit `data/connectors.csv` (leg side) or `data/pmu_pins.csv` (PMU side) and run `gen.py`.

Status: **LIVE** · **PROVISIONED** wire run and capped, hardware fitted empty · **RESERVED** LS swap · **DEFERRED** subsystem not designed yet · **OPEN** needs a PMU pin or fuse position that does not exist yet (see `OPEN.md`) · **SPARE** capped.

## Counts

| Group | Housings (mated pairs) |
|---|---|
| Leg housings L1–L4 (L1-S is two housings) | 15 |
| Door sub-connectors at the sill | 2 |
| Dash-post drops (ICU, DCU, DIAG, KEY) | 4 |
| Lugs (DP-BAT, DP-GND) | 2 |
| PMU device connector | 1 |
| **Total mated pairs** | **24** |

A *mated pair* is one plug and its receptacle. Lugs count as pairs; the four dash-post drops are pairs. Earlier files said 20 and 23 by counting different things, and 14 leg connectors by counting L1-S once — this table is the count.
